drums.tags: Stomp and clap percussion track. The arrangement consists of a layered acoustic kick drum, hand claps, and a wooden stomp sound. The rhythm follows a syncopated pattern with a heavy emphasis on the downbeat followed by a double-clap on the offbeats. The recording features a natural room reverb with a short decay. The tempo is 100 BPM in 4/4 time. The kick drum has a prominent sub-bass frequency boost, while the claps are layered with a slight stereo spread. The stomp sound has a mid-range wood-block timbre.

bass.tags: Hard rock. Distorted electric guitar plays a syncopated, palm-muted riff centered on E. A second electric guitar provides sustained power chords and melodic lead fills with high-gain saturation. The bass guitar follows the root notes of the guitar riff with a gritty, overdriven tone. Drums feature a heavy, compressed kick and a crisp snare with a short plate reverb. The arrangement follows a linear progression with a focus on rhythmic interplay between the kick drum and the muted guitar chugging. 120 BPM. 4/4 time signature. Key of E minor.
